name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debates/?id=2023-11-30.34.2) to agree with the Senate amendments, which means the bill has now been passed in both house of parliament in its final form and so can now become law. ### What are the Senate amendments? Several amendments were agreed in the Senate, with the text of these amendments [available here](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Fsched%2Fr7076_sched_52200819-0eeb-476b-bdcb-5960892c8f5c%22;rec=0). Some of these amendments have a relevant explanatory memorandum, which is a political document that is prepared by the proposing party. You can find these memoranda on the [bills homepage](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/r7076) by matching the title of the amendment with the relevant explanatory memorandum. For example, the [first amendment listed](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Fsched%2Fr7076_sched_52200819-0eeb-476b-bdcb-5960892c8f5c%22;rec=0) is labelled "sheet ZC243 revised" and can be matched with the [Supplementary explanatory memorandum relating to sheet ZC243](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Fems%2Fr7076_ems_00571692-d027-43a3-8459-5a03d8645b1f%22;rec=0). ### What does the bill do?
